expectedIssues: Profile is highlighted in the bottom nav bar while the home feed is shown
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is hard-clipped by the viewport edge — the image, title and delivery price are all cut mid-character with no ellipsis or fade, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.

Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/black circle with a white heart.
The category filter chip row ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy…') is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving the impression of a rendering glitch.
The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while the neighbouring thumbnails use dark backgrounds, breaking visual rhythm in the row.
The pizza card at the bottom is abruptly cut by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom scroll padding, so the card's title/metadata sit hidden behind the tab bar.

expected.reasoning: None of the reported issues describe a navigation bar highlighting mismatch; all reported issues concern carousel/card layout, styling, and clipping problems.
